meta.addText: CANONICAL CONDITION PHRASING: word every condition as "<Loss-form> of <function capability noun phrase>[ — <qualifier>]" using EXACTLY these loss-forms: "Complete loss of", "Partial loss of", "Erroneous", "Uncommanded", "Inadvertent", "Undetected". The capability noun phrase repeats the function's own wording (e.g. function "Provide thrust" -> "Complete loss of thrust generation"). Qualifiers state scope/phase/detectability only ("— asymmetric", "— below crew detection threshold"). Never synonymise loss-forms (no "total/full/gross loss", no "spurious/false" where Erroneous applies).
